benchmark.qualification: Small local baseline only; not a release latency claim.

implementation_requirements: Keep persisted ciphertext and Argon2 strength unchanged.
Bind managed material to owner, record revision, provider contract and encryption-key version.
Evaluate shared grants independently of the cached secret.
Fence old in-flight loads after revocation and rotation.
Bound entries, retained bytes, concurrent cold loads and per-tenant work.
Refresh outside warm requests and refuse expired material.
Use events only as hints; recover missed events through bounded validation.
Own worker start and cancellation in application lifecycle.
next_action: Implement the managed-material lifecycle and integrate local mutation invalidation, bounded remote freshness, shared grants, and request validity. Then run A45 and full credential/router tests.
